capabilities: Sync vaults or folders between devices with end-to-end encryption (rclone crypt)
Publish selected notes to the server so MCP clients can read and search them
Apply AI-suggested edits only when access rules allow and the note has not changed
Add devices by QR code and manage vaults, devices, tokens and assistant access keys
Onboard users through accounts, invitations and a first-launch setup wizard
extras: Not yet in the community plugin directory; installed via BRAT or manually. Full user guide is only in Russian (docs/PLUGIN.md). AI access is off by default; allowed notes are published to the server in plain text for indexing, unlike encrypted synced files. A warning notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Syncing a vault across devices normally requires a hosted service, and there is no built-in way to give AI assistants controlled, rule-based access to specific notes.

relations.evidence: It works with your own server, sync-and-mcp-backend.
With BRAT (recommended). Install BRAT, run the command "BRAT: Add a beta plugin for testing"
The plugin then shows a ready command for Claude Code, a config for Claude Desktop

summary: Self-hosted, end-to-end encrypted vault sync that also exposes selected notes to AI assistants through an MCP endpoint.
